name: Audit-Grade Approval & Policy Chain Engine
tagline: Multi-step approval chains with per-step dual control, bound to immutable policy versions — every decision an auditable evidence record.
business_problem: Approvals must prove WHO approved WHAT under WHICH policy version at the moment of the decision; spreadsheets and ad-hoc emails cannot.
engineering_problem: A generic N-step approval chain engine with per-step approver counts, role gating, segregation of duties, policy-version pinning and an append-only decision evidence trail.
why_industrial: Requests are bound to the exact policy-version snapshot in force at creation, chains enforce dual control per step, and auditors can replay the full decision trail.
demo_narrative: Captured against a running instance: **policy activation → 3-step chain creation (MANAGER×2 → DIRECTOR → LEGAL) → request bound to policy v1 → SoD blocks the requester → dual-control manager approvals → step advancement → APPROVED → the full decision evidence trail.**

highlights: requests capture the active policy version at creation; new versions never rewrite history
each chain step declares a role and the number of distinct approvers required
requesters can never decide their own requests — enforced in the domain, tested
every decision is append-only with approver, role step, timestamp and note
stale pending requests are extended and surfaced via events on a schedule
